title: Monotonicity conjecture for a gamma-function quotient
statement:
Let $a,c\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $0\le a\le 1$ and $c>4$. Consider the quotient

$$
\frac{\Gamma(c)\Gamma(c-4)}{\Gamma(c-a)\Gamma(c+a-1)}.
$$

**Gamma-quotient monotonicity conjecture.** The quotient decreases as $c$ increases.

The conjecture extends the preceding lemma, which establishes the same monotonicity for $1<a<4$ and $-3<a<0$. The source notes that the remaining range $0\le a\le 1$ is suggested by computer experimentation, but provides no proof or resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.07701

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2017).
source_name: Hina Manoj Arora and Swadesh Kumar Sahoo, “Interpolation on Gauss hypergeometric functions with an application”, arXiv:1707.07701 (2017).
